IntroducedBillHeader.Sponsors: House Committee on Appropriations (originally sponsored by Representatives P. Sullivan, Simpson and Dunn)

Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring the department of corrections to post on its web site information on escapees.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to a web site for information on fugitives; andadding a new section to chapter 72.09 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 72.09 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The department of corrections shall, within available resources,establish a public list, on the department's web site, of all highriskinmates who have escaped from correctional institutions and facilitiesoperated or contracted by the department.
